pkgmetadata.longdescription: LSP (Linux Studio Plugins) is a collection of audio plugins in CLAP, GStreamer, LADSPA, LV2, VST2 and VST3 formats, and standalone applications with dummy, JACK and PipeWire audio backends.

use.flag: Enable the native PipeWire backend for standalone applications
Build standalone applications, including the built-in dummy audio backend
